about: Every library the frontends use, what it is for and its rules. The versions come from each project's package.json (`npm run libraries` reads them again): the kit, substance-tracker and vtiger-reader. A new library goes here first, with its reason, before an app installs it.

libraries.name: Angular
libraries.role: The frontend framework of every app: standalone components, signals, the router, forms, HttpClient. Client-side only.
rules: Standalone components, signal inputs and outputs (input(), output(), model()), the new control flow (@if, @for, @switch).
Every component, service, pipe, guard, directive and interceptor is made with `ng generate`, never by hand (lenzi, 2026-09-29).
No SSR: a client-side single-page app.
Every page is a lazy route (loadComponent): the first bundle stays small.
Route parameters and data arrive as inputs (withComponentInputBinding).

libraries.name: Angular CDK
libraries.role: Overlays, portals, focus trapping, layout: what Material is built on.
rules: Use it for behaviour Material does not have (a page window's focus trap), never to draw a component of its own look.

libraries.name: RxJS
rules: State lives in signals; RxJS stays at the edges (HTTP, events). Load data with rxResource, keep it on screen with keptValue.

libraries.name: Angular Material
libraries.role: The only UI component library: Material 3, heavily modified by the kit (dark violet, glass, 2 px borders, Roboto Mono, 32 px pills).
rules: No other UI or CSS framework (no Tailwind, no Bootstrap, no PrimeNG): Material and the kit.
The kit's styles modify Material once, globally (styles/global.css): an app never restyles a Material component locally.
Custom CSS only for layout and for what Material does not have (a segmented bar, identity colours).

libraries.name: Roboto Mono (Fontsource)
libraries.role: The one font of every app, bundled with it (works offline, under a strict CSP).
rules: One font for everything (lenzi, 2026-10-02: "Usa roboto mono per tutto"); weights 400, 500, 700 and italic; through styles/fonts.css.

libraries.name: Material Icons
libraries.role: The icons, filled, bundled with the app.
rules: Filled icons only, through <mat-icon>; an icon that carries meaning has a text or an aria-label next to it.

libraries.name: Apache ECharts
libraries.role: The charts: bars, lines, donut, treemap, radar, drawn in SVG.
rules: Only through LenziChart (@lenzi/ui-kit/charts): the one component that knows the chart library.
The modular import only (echarts/core plus the pieces used): never the whole of ECharts.
The SVG renderer; the theme's colours read from its variables.

libraries.name: ngx-echarts
libraries.role: The Angular directive around ECharts (resizing, updates).
rules: Only inside LenziChart.

libraries.name: three.js
libraries.role: 3D, for later (lenzi, 2026-11-12: "we don't use it now, but we might").
rules: Only through LenziThreeCanvas (@lenzi/ui-kit/three): it owns the renderer, the size, the frame loop and freeing the GPU memory.
A page with 3D is a lazy route: three.js is heavy.
Colours from the theme (context.color('--mat-sys-primary')), never hard-coded.

libraries.name: Capacitor
libraries.role: substance-tracker's Android app: the website packed as an APK.
rules: The web stays the source: the app is the same pages, edge to edge, with the safe-area insets the kit already respects.

libraries.name: Electron
libraries.role: vtiger-reader's desktop app for Windows: the Angular pages and a Fastify API inside one window.
rules: The pages are the same as on the web: the kit's look, the kit's components.

libraries.name: Angular CLI and build
libraries.role: Builds (esbuild), the dev server, the unit-test runner.
rules: `ng generate` for every Angular artifact; `ng build` must pass with no error before anything is handed over.

libraries.name: ng-packagr
libraries.role: Packs the kit as an Angular library, with its entry points (charts, three, http).
rules: The kit only.

libraries.name: TypeScript
libraries.role: The language of every frontend, strict.
rules: strict, strictTemplates; code, names and comments in English.

libraries.name: Vitest
libraries.role: Unit tests, through Angular's unit-test builder, in jsdom.
rules: Every component of the kit has tests of what it does from outside: its inputs, its outputs, what it shows.

libraries.name: Prettier
rules: The workspace's .prettierrc: 140 columns, single quotes.

libraries.name: marked
libraries.role: Shows the kit's Markdown (rules, AI notes) as pages.
rules: Catalog only: the apps do not render Markdown.

libraries.name: highlight.js
libraries.role: Colours the code shown in the catalog, in the theme's colours.
rules: Catalog only; the languages the kit is written in, nothing else.

libraries.name: Fastify
libraries.role: The kit's server (saving the variables, serving the catalog in Docker); the API of both apps.
rules: Errors as Problem Details (RFC 9457), the shape lenziErrorInterceptor reads.
